# HCBTECH

HCBTECH is an Indonesian machining and fabrication business with a coconut-machinery catalog. Indonesian is the default language; English uses `?lang=en`.

## Current catalog

- [Coconut graters](/mesin/parut-kelapa): Mini, standing, and Jumbo; five configurations from the owner’s price sheet.
- [Coconut shell peelers](/mesin/kupas-batok-kelapa): floor-mounted (Ampar tanpa kaki), seated (Duduk), standing (Berdiri); five configurations.
- [Coconut milk presses](/mesin/peras-santan): Mini A10, A11, A22, A33; four configurations.

Prices are references transcribed from the owner’s price list received 21 November 2026. They have no confirmed effective date and must be reconfirmed before ordering. Stock, delivery, tax, warranty, and included accessories are not established by this list. The source is available at /docs/daftar-harga.jpeg.

Original owner photos are family references. No exact photo-to-price-variant association is claimed. Three GLB exterior studies exist for a standing electric grater, an electric disc/gearbox shell-peeler layout, and a hopper/roller milk-press layout. They are unmeasured visual approximations, not models of all variants, engineering drawings, internal mechanisms, or verified dimensions.

Legacy REF layout pages remain accessible for old links and are marked noindex. They are not the current model catalog.

## Contact

Business WhatsApp: +62 853-1552-7000. Quotation links include the chosen family, variant, price-list reference and request text. The customer sends the message manually in WhatsApp; the site does not claim automatic delivery.

Owner-supplied social profiles: https://www.facebook.com/anto.nugraha.kedua/ and https://www.tiktok.com/@mangatto_cees.

Capacity, measured dimensions, material grades, stock, address, hours, warranty, and delivery coverage remain unconfirmed where absent from the catalog. Do not infer them from images or models.
